$comment: LEVEL 4 -- DILIM. The dark forest on Mt. Makiling. The design record is LEVEL_4.md; the
decisions in it are Kent's (2026-10-15/16) and are not re-litigated here.
WHAT IS DIFFERENT FROM LEVELS 1-3, and where each lives:
- the apo goes alone (no Lolo) and every line is hers -- level_4.gd's hooks, dialogue_l4.json;
- the lantern is her health, and the woods are dark -- _has_player_health, _darkness;
- every encounter is answered BY WHAT SHE DOES: drawing the route's tag, doing the route's
deed (a route that is `answered_by` a deed asks for no drawing at all, as Piyesta's dance), or
fighting. There is no choice popup; the first answer given is the route taken;
- the ending gets ONE point from Dilim, its majority route (`tally`) -- level_director.gd.
display_name_note: Tagalog: darkness. Where Lolo cannot follow.
goal: Cross the dark forest on Mt. Makiling and last until morning.

checkpoints.$comment: The first rest clearing, saved as she walks in. Its lantern stands where the light is made and is lit by it: the lamp and the ink refilled, a curse lifted.
The last clearing's edge. A knockout in the finale puts her here with the waves and the clock reset.

ink_economy.$comment: Every weapon or light drawn costs a unit (_every_drawing_costs_ink); a creature form drains 0.25 a second. Rest clearings and CP3 refill; two jars stand before the kapre and the bungisngis.

objectives.$comment: In her own voice, short enough for the banner (720 px), naming no class. At each encounter not yet answered, its ways past, plainly: the arrival lines are Lola remembered, and a memory is not an instruction.
objectives.edge: Cross the woods. Keep the lamp lit.
objectives.woods: Get through the woods. Keep the lamp lit.
objectives.rest: Make a light here. It fills the lamp again.
objectives.nuno: Stop at the mound, ask to pass ({key:interact}), then jump it.
objectives.sigbin: Show it light, or keep my back to a rock, or fight it off.
objectives.tikbalang: Go by as something with hooves, or as an animal, or race it.
objectives.kapre: Blow its smoke away, cut down what it sits in, or knock its cigar.
objectives.tiyanak: Keep to the high path. Or show it light. Or fight it.
objectives.bungisngis: Make it laugh with something silly, go over it, or fight it.
objectives.manananggal: Salt the half she left behind, hold light on it, or drive her off.

artist.$comment: Stop beside the mound and ask to pass; cross without touching its crown. The flower rises.

pragmatist.$comment: Cross without touching the crown, and without asking.

obstacles.$comment: No protector route: the nuno has no hurtbox. Touching the crown curses her (slower, lower jumps, the lantern down a stage) and answers nothing.
A light of her own -- a fire, a lamp, the sun -- fills the lantern and lifts the nuno's curse. Arriving fills the ink first, so she can always draw it.

artist.$comment: Show it the light; it flees.

pragmatist.$comment: Stand with her back to a surface for five seconds: it hunts from behind.

protector.$comment: Drawing something to strike with is the choice; driving it off is the answer.

artist.$comment: A body with hooves: it takes her for one of its own.

pragmatist.$comment: Any animal body: become something it does not chase.

protector.$comment: Race it to the landmark rock and win (it runs 245, she 260).

artist.$comment: Blow its smoke away: the fan drawn is the choice, held up to the smoke the answer.

pragmatist.$comment: Cut the tree it sits in: the blade drawn is the choice, three chops the answer.

protector.$comment: Knock the cigar out of its hand, 260 px up: only what leaves the hand reaches.

obstacles.$comment: A light of her own -- a fire, a lamp, the sun -- fills the lantern and lifts the nuno's curse. Arriving fills the ink first, so she can always draw it.

artist.$comment: Light shows it for what it is; it flees.

pragmatist.$comment: Reach the far side on the path, without once going down toward the cry.

protector.$comment: Drawing something to strike with is the choice; striking it down is the answer. Allowed, never rewarded: it drops nothing, and she says so.

artist.$comment: Something with no business on a mountain, brought within 420 px of it for half a second: it laughs itself helpless and sits out of the way.

pragmatist.$comment: Over the ravine on a bridge, or up onto the high path: the far bank reached while it still stands in the crossing.

protector.$comment: Drawing something to strike with is the choice; beating it is the answer. The straight fight.

artist.$comment: A light drawn is the choice; the lower half held in light for two seconds -- the sun lights the whole hollow -- is the answer. She cannot rejoin in the light.

pragmatist.$comment: Salt on the lower half while the upper is away.

protector.$comment: Drawing something to strike with is the choice; driving the upper half off is the answer. It settles the least: the lower half still stands.

obstacles.$comment: Survive until dawn: three waves on a clock, and the sun ends it.

hidden_flowers.$comment: For the one who stopped and asked to pass.

load_time_assertions: every route with required_tags resolves >= 2 classes after exclusions (BR-7: held-out recall >= 0.70)
every encounter has a route that is not a fight
an ink jar or an ink-free route stands before every encounter that needs a drawing
the nuno has no hurtbox and no protector route; the tiyanak drops nothing
no story line is spoken mid-encounter
